title: Invested in this start up but can’t recommend the product.
text: Invested in this start up but can’t recommend the product.. I was a investor in the Kickstarter for this Gravity Blanket . This was about three years ago and I invested because I thought it was a great concept and I’ve  struggled with insomnia for years plus Fibromyalgia.  When they finally went in to production and I received my complimentary blanket I was extremely disappointed. To begin with, they  Sent me a 30lb blanket and I’m a petite 125 lb person so it was impossible to move under it. There were no baffles to separate it into sections so the beads shifted and clumped ( which I see they haven’t fixed yet). I made several attempts to contact the company to ask for a lighter blanket and got no response ( I see there are still complaints about poor Customer Service).  I did like the feel of the fabric , it was plush but there was no was to clean it and no duvet. For the price they charge I would never recommend buying this brand. There are others now that are much better made and cost less. I bought a QUILITY brand that came with a cover and it’s so much nicer.

product_metadata.title: Gravity Blanket Weighted Blanket for Adults, 15lbs White 48"x72" Twin/Single, The Original Weighted Blanket for Sleep, Cotton Made Blanket with Washable Removable Microfiber Duvet Cover
features: TROUBLE SLEEPING? Gravity Blanket offers a Premium Weighted Blanket that uses lightweight on the body to improve sleep quality. The latest generation of Gravity's Original Blanket features internal upgrades while maintaining the blanket's signature look and feel.

HIGH-QUALITY DESIGN: Our exterior Duvet Cover is made of super-soft micro-fleece material. While the interior of the Weighted Blanket is made of 100% cotton and fine-grade glass beads. Our upgraded zipper system helps the blanket stay inside the duvet. Gridded stitching on the weighted inner ensures the glass beads remain uniformly distributed that helps you wind down.

PERFECT SIZE: Our Weighted Blanket measures 48"x72", providing a grounding experience for one user at a time. Use our Gravity Blanket weight chart below to find the perfect fit for this comfortable blanket. We recommended that you select one of our Weighted Blankets that’s about 10% of your body weight. We designed it in this throw blanket size to allow the weight to be evenly distributed over the user and because each user requires a weight specific to their body weight.

CARE & LONG-LASTING: Our Breathable Duvet cover is machine washable while the internal blanket should be hand-washed only. To ensure your Blanket lasts, remove the cover before washing, and machine wash in cold water with similar colors. It is recommended to tumble dry on low and cool iron if needed. Not sure which Gravity Blanket to choose from? We offer our Original Weighted Blanket in 15, 20, and 35lb options and in different colors.
